content:
As I acquired more knowledge about this growing menace inside my body, I discovered that it was actually the cause of many other subsequent major illnesses. By compromising my immune system, the Candida made me vulnerable to a host of other problems, including polio, leukemia, and most recently, to a type of fungus that grew in my liver.

My arduous search for good health led me to the Hippocrates Wellness, where I spent three weeks of intensive detoxification, cleansing and rejuvenation. After my initial consultation with the Institute’s director, Brian Clement, I actively participated in a health encounter that offered a complete change of diet and lifestyle, the use of pure, natural remedies, and a supportive, healing environment.

After three weeks, the rash gradually disappeared, my abdomen decreased by about 3/4 of its former size, and I began to experience a great sense of well-being — as if a heavy load was lifted off me. I was told that this was the result of toxins being eliminated from my body. My white hair has returned to its original brown color. I am finally back to good health as I continue adhering to this remarkable program.

The support and genuine concern of everyone at the Institute are a powerful immune booster. Thank you again for all your help!
